title: Constant-sheaf cohomology of a strictly henselian local scheme
statement:
Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], let $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a finite abelian group whose order is invertible in $R$. Write $\underline A$ for the associated constant étale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then

$$
H^q(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\underline A)=\begin{cases}A,&q=0,\\0,&q>0,\end{cases}
$$

for étale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

proof.text: For $q>0$, write $q=n+1$ with $n\ge0$. The constant sheaf $\underline A$ is an abelian étale sheaf. Apply the vanishing clause of [lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-etale-acyclic] with $S=X$, $\mathcal F=\underline A$ and $p=q\ge1$ to obtain $H^q(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\underline A)=0$.
For $q=0$, apply [lem-sbc-strict-henselian-constant-hzero] to the abelian group $A$; it gives the canonical identification $H^0(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\underline A)\simeq A$.
